_source: Lean core for every code route (docs/design/lean-core.md): Codex's design with a short codex-tuned prompt, workspace preload, re-check on edit and no extra verification layers. Measured on the 52 eval tasks, paired against Codex 0.171 on the same model, 3 rounds (docs/results/final20-22, verified in docs/results/verify-final20-22.md): 294/312 vs 280/312 solved, cost per solved 0.77x (95% CI 0.64-0.89), median per-task time 0.74x. The previous default is kept as the "codex" profile (MH_PROFILE=codex).
